## Editing task / 해결할 편집 작업

Who is trying to do what, and where does the current workflow fall short?

## Proposed behavior / 원하는 동작

Give a concrete before/after example. Include relevant input and output conditions.

## Current workaround / 현재 방법

Describe the workaround and why it is insufficient.

## Acceptance / 완료 확인 방법

What could another user do to confirm the feature works? Consider save/reopen, Undo/Redo, cancellation and export when relevant.

## Examples / 예시

Link only publicly shareable examples. Identify the specific behavior you want rather than requesting general parity with another editor. English and Korean are welcome.
